name: parameters
source_text: Only automatable parameters are accessible. See DeviceParameter to learn how to modify them.

name: can_have_chains
source_text: 0 for a single device 1 for a device Rack

name: class_display_name
source_text: Get the original name of the device (e.g. Operator, Auto Filter).

name: class_name
source_text: Live device type such as MidiChord, Operator, Limiter, MxDeviceAudioEffect, or PluginDevice.

name: is_active
source_text: 0 = either the device itself or its enclosing Rack device is off.

name: name
source_text: This is the string shown in the title bar of the device.

name: type
source_text: The type of the device. Possible types are: 0 = undefined, 1 = instrument, 2 = audio_effect, 4 = midi_effect.

name: can_compare_ab
source_text: 1 for devices that support the AB Compare feature. 0 otherwise. Available since Live 12.3.

name: is_using_compare_preset_b
source_text: 1 if the device has compare preset B loaded. 0 otherwise. (Only relevant if can_compare_ab, otherwise errors.) Available since Live 12.3.

name: store_chosen_bank
source_text: Parameters: script_index [int] bank_index [int] (This is related to hardware control surfaces and is usually not relevant.)

name: save_preset_to_compare_ab_slot
source_text: Save the device state to the other compare AB slot. (Only relevant if can_compare_ab, otherwise errors.) Available since Live 12.3.

name: is_collapsed
source_text: 1 = the device is shown collapsed in the device chain.

name: automation_state
source_text: Get the automation state of the parameter. 0 = no automation. 1 = automation active. 2 = automation overridden.

name: default_value
source_text: Get the default value for this parameter. Only available for parameters that aren't quantized (see is_quantized).

name: is_enabled
source_text: 1 = the parameter value can be modified directly by the user, by sending set to a live.object, by automation or by an assigned MIDI message or keystroke. Parameters can be disabled because they are macro-controlled, or they are controlled by a live-remote~ object, or because Live thinks that they should not be moved.

name: is_quantized
source_text: 1 for booleans and enums 0 for int/float parameters Although parameters like MidiPitch.Pitch appear quantized to the user, they actually have an is_quantized value of 0.

name: name
source_text: The short parameter name as shown in the (closed) automation chooser.

name: original_name
source_text: The name of a Macro parameter before its assignment.

name: state
source_text: The active state of the parameter. 0 = the parameter is active and can be changed. 1 = the parameter can be changed but isn't active, so changes won't have an audible effect. 2 = the parameter cannot be changed.

name: value
source_text: The internal value between min and max. Use display_value for the value as visible in the GUI.

name: display_value
source_text: The value as visible in the GUI.

name: value_items
source_text: Get a list of the possible values for this parameter. Only available for parameters that are quantized (see is_quantized).

name: str_for_value
source_text: Parameter: value [float] Returns: [symbol] String representation of the specified value.

name: __str__
source_text: Returns: [symbol] String representation of the current parameter value.

name: left_split_stereo
source_text: The Track's Left Split Stereo Pan Parameter.

name: right_split_stereo
source_text: The Track's Right Split Stereo Pan Parameter.

name: crossfade_assign
source_text: 0 = A, 1 = none, 2 = B [not in master track]

name: panning_mode
source_text: Access to the Track mixer's pan mode: 0 = Stereo, 1 = Split Stereo.

name: chain_selector
source_text: Convenience accessor for the Rack's chain selector.

name: drum_pads
source_text: All 128 Drum Pads for the topmost Drum Rack. Inner Drum Racks return a list of 0 entries.

name: visible_drum_pads
source_text: All 16 visible DrumPads for the topmost Drum Rack. Inner Drum Racks return a list of 0 entries.

name: can_show_chains
source_text: 1 = The Rack contains an instrument device that is capable of showing its chains in Session View.

name: has_drum_pads
source_text: 1 = the device is a Drum Rack with pads. A nested Drum Rack is a Drum Rack without pads. Only available for Drum Racks.

name: has_macro_mappings
source_text: 1 = any of a Rack's Macros are mapped to a parameter.

name: is_showing_chains
source_text: 1 = The Rack contains an instrument device that is showing its chains in Session View.

name: variation_count
source_text: The number of currently stored macro variations. Available since Live 11.0.

name: selected_variation_index
source_text: Get/set the currently selected variation. Available since Live 11.0.

name: visible_macro_count
source_text: The number of currently visible macros.

name: copy_pad
source_text: Parameters: source_index [int] destination_index [int] Copies all content of a Drum Rack pad from a source pad to a destination pad. The source_index and destination_index refer to pad indices inside a Drum Rack.

name: add_macro
source_text: Increases the number of visible macro controls. Available since Live 11.0.

name: insert_chain
source_text: Parameters: index [int] (optional) Attempts to insert a new chain at the given index, or at the end of the chain list if no index is provided. Throws an error if insertion is not possible. Available since Live 12.3.

name: remove_macro
source_text: Decreases the number of visible macro controls. Available since Live 11.0.

name: randomize_macros
source_text: Randomizes the values of eligible macro controls. Available since Live 11.0.

name: store_variation
source_text: Stores a new variation of the values of all currently mapped macros. Available since Live 11.0.

name: recall_selected_variation
source_text: Recalls the currently selected macro variation. Available since Live 11.0.

name: recall_last_used_variation
source_text: Recalls the macro variation that was recalled most recently. Available since Live 11.0.

name: delete_selected_variation
source_text: Deletes the currently selected macro variation. Does nothing if there is no selected variation. Available since Live 11.0.

name: selected_drum_pad
source_text: Currently selected Drum Rack pad. Only available for Drum Racks.

name: drum_pads_scroll_position
source_text: Lowest row of pads visible, range: 0 - 28. Only available for Drum Racks.

name: is_showing_chain_devices
source_text: 1 = the devices in the currently selected chain are visible.

name: color
source_text: The RGB value of the chain's color in the form 0x00rrggbb or (2^16 * red) + (2^8) * green + blue, where red, green and blue are values from 0 (dark) to 255 (light). When setting the RGB value, the nearest color from the color chooser is taken.

name: color_index
source_text: The color index of the chain.

name: is_auto_colored
source_text: 1 = the chain will always have the color of the containing track or chain.

name: muted_via_solo
source_text: 1 = muted due to another chain being soloed.

name: solo
source_text: 1 = soloed (Solo switch on) does not automatically turn Solo off in other chains.

name: delete_device
source_text: Parameter: index [int] Delete the device at the given index.

name: insert_device
source_text: Parameters: device_name [symbol] target_index [int] (optional) Attempts to insert the device specified by device_name at the given index in the chain. If no index is provided, attempts to insert the device at the end. Throws an error if insertion is not possible. device_name is the name as it appears in the UI of Live. Not all indices are valid. As can be expected, indices outside of the range defined by the current length of the device chain are invalid, but there are other limitations: for example, a MIDI effect can't be inserted after an instrument. The rule of thumb is that if an index would be invalid when inserting using the mouse, it's invalid here. At the moment, only native Live devices can be inserted. Max for Live devices and plug-in are not supported. Available since Live 12.3.

name: sends
source_text: [in Audio Effect Racks and Instrument Racks only] For Drum Racks, otherwise empty.

name: panning
source_text: [in Audio Effect Racks and Instrument Racks only]

name: volume
source_text: [in Audio Effect Racks and Instrument Racks only]

name: in_note
source_text: Get/set the MIDI note that will trigger this chain. The value -1 corresponds to the "All Notes" setting in the UI. Available since Live 12.3

name: out_note
source_text: Get/set the MIDI note sent to the devices in the chain.

name: solo
source_text: 1 = soloed (Solo switch on) Does not automatically turn Solo off in other chains.
